sources.title: OpenAI Codex (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: OpenAI Codex is a large language model developed by OpenAI for translating natural-language prompts into source code. Announced in 2021, it was a modified production version of GPT-3 that was fine-tuned on source code in multiple programming languages, and it served as the original model for GitHub Copilot.
